publication_unit: Eight theoretical reader essays plus a separate introduction, eight documented cases and closing interlude.
editorial_checks: Lead read all eighteen published Chinese essays in full and the cases' complete source titles, notes and historical limits.

Every new foreign essay and ancillary field was read by a different editor from its author. Accepted source-based local corrections were applied, then affected saved prose and metadata were actually reread.
All forty-two case source entries are complete in each language; their original IDs, URLs and in-paragraph citation sequences are preserved.
Historical cutoffs and evidence boundaries are retained. A new language publication date is not a claim of updated research, payment receipt, final litigation outcome or implementation success.
The theory's fictional scenes and the documented cases remain separate. Both routes have same-language companion links without implying that cases prove a predetermined verdict.

preservation.method: Both pre-expansion baselines equal the final preservation receipts. Primary changes are language controls and alternate links, not rewritten source prose or new original publication dates.

automated_checks.scope: Political-economy primary and foreign routes, cited sources, preservation and review seals, grouped indexes, shared-language and state/interstate regressions, bounded Home, analytics and recorded sitemap dates.

browser_checks: Actual German case-to-theory and theory-to-case clicks remain in German; the seven-plus-one theoretical grouping and one/eight/one case grouping have unique working jump targets.
The main theory group lands below the fixed header after scrolling; its ID no longer collides with the page's main landmark.
The eight-language dropdown switches the Thames case from German to Japanese, and back to the original Traditional Chinese mode at the same case URL.
Expanded Japanese sources display the full historical note and all five full source entries; two final compressed source-note phrases were clarified and independently reread before sealing.
Desktop and 375px mobile checks show no horizontal overflow. Mobile uses a single card column and a two-column eight-language menu. German heading hyphenation was added and verified visually.
The temporary mobile viewport was reset and the default 1280px viewport verified.
proof_image_location: Local Codex workspace; not added to the public site's image payload.
limits: AI-assisted independent writing and editorial cross-review, not human native-speaker certification.
Coverage counts, citation alignment and tests supplement full-prose reading; they are not quality scores.
The existing English and Chinese source editions were preserved, not newly certified as translations of the technical papers.
deployment: Local series commit only; the author pushes.
